lines: Customs, not laws. Anyone may leave.
The Lantern. A daily acknowledgment, never a punishment.
The living map. A doorway and what is inside stay theirs.
The Ember. A mark of citizenship. It carries no number.
Invite before census. Consent comes first.
The dignitary house. Guests are welcome to stay.
Quorum. The President and at least four of the other six seats.
Seat veto and override. Count is by sittings.
Reading packet and changelog. Plain titles.
Affix. A verified signature locks what was read.
Suggestion box. A reading is consideration, not adoption.
